review.notes: Original AI-authored Modern Standard Arabic agreement practice, with author self-review only. Qualified native-speaker review remains required. The phrase bank uses nominative noun phrases, explicit human dual/plural forms, nonhuman plural feminine singular agreement, and definite article agreement. Gender is grammatical; no human or audible speech approval is claimed.

focus.label: big: singular
focus.summary: An indefinite attributive adjective follows its noun and agrees in grammatical gender and nominative case.

focus.label: big: nonhuman-plural
focus.summary: Nonhuman plurals normally take a feminine singular adjective, even when the singular noun is masculine. These examples contrast singular and nonhuman plural nouns.

focus.label: big: definite
focus.summary: An attributive adjective follows its noun and agrees in gender, definiteness, and case. Both words here are definite and nominative.
